objective.title: Extract checked theorem dependencies and expose obligation graph and reusable theorem search
objective.statement: Build an executable Lean declaration exporter plus local CLI for catalog snapshots, mathematical description/type search, and a validated planned mission graph joined to actual checked dependencies. Distinguish theorem proofs, arbitrary unresolved hypotheses, planned nodes, and absent endpoint. Bind artifacts to source identities and reject stale evidence/cycles/false closure. Add tests and minimal CLI documentation. The tool is read-only with respect to proof source and does not infer proof completion from names, imports, job status, or graph reachability alone.
deliverables: Extract checked theorem dependencies and expose obligation graph and reusable theorem search

stop_conditions: Stop at the stated file scope; report exact resisting types and preserved compiler failures if blocked.
No service operations, full builds, merges, task acceptance, or final-target claim.
